seeds.headline: The Synthesis Trap: Why Bitcoin's 21M Becomes Priceless When AI Destroys Everything Else
seeds.angle: Jordi Visser thesis—AI doesn't inflate asset values, it demolishes them by making intelligence free. Only non-synthesizable scarcity survives. Why Bitcoin's fixed supply becomes the only real hedge.

seeds.headline: Morgan Stanley Just Quietly Changed Bitcoin Adoption Forever—Here's What Clarity Act Actually Unleashed
seeds.angle: Full advisor network distribution going live. Regulatory cover was the last friction point. Post-Clarity, post-tax-season capital redeployment compounds institutional demand. Timeline and operational reality.

seeds.headline: From Money to Minds: How Self-Sovereign AI Agents Replicate Bitcoin's 2009 Revolution in 2024
seeds.angle: Preston Pysh and Justin Moon's parallel: local AI agents answering to nobody mirrors Bitcoin's sovereignty thesis. Same problem, different layer. Why decentralized computation and scarce money are now joined at the hip.
